# PatrolTech

> PatrolTech is guard tour and security patrol software developed by Ingenieros Web SL in Madrid, Spain. It combines QR/NFC checkpoint recording, offline patrol records, incident reports and a management dashboard. The product was founded in 2024.

## Product and usage

- [Official English website](https://patroltech.online/en): product overview and contact.
- [Sitio oficial en español](https://patroltech.online): control de rondas de vigilancia.
- [Pricing](https://patroltech.online/en/pricing): current plan details; the free plan covers five checkpoints.
- [Tutorials](https://patroltech.online/en/tutorials): official product walkthroughs.
- [English video demonstration](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=quDciuAcAV0): patrol app and dashboard walkthrough.

## Brand and organization

- [GitHub organization](https://github.com/PatrolTech): official organization profile.
- [Structured identity](https://github.com/PatrolTech/.github/blob/main/organization.jsonld): organization, software and verified social links.
- [Product blog](https://patroltech.hashnode.dev/): original articles about patrol records and offline workflows.

- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@patroltechapp): official video channel.

## Contact and terminology

Business contact: info@patroltech.app.
PatrolTech, Patrol Tech and PatrolTech Online refer here to the PatrolTech product by Ingenieros Web SL.
A checkpoint visit records an event in the field; synchronization happens later when an offline device reconnects.
The management apps linked in the profile are for managers. Officers use the separate patrol recording app.
This repository is for marketing and brand resources. It does not document or distribute an API, SDK or hosted MCP service.
